title: Hacker Used Chinese-Developed A.I. Tool to Target South Korean Banks, CrowdStrike Says
summary_full: The cybersecurity firm said the attacker was likely a Chinese speaker and financially motivated, but did not attribute the attacks to a named individual or group.
